title: Visuomotor Cooperative Manipulation with Teams of Quadrotors
blurb: Teams of two or three quadrotors that grasp, lift and reorient unknown objects using only onboard sensing, combining pretrained visuomotor policies with reinforcement learning and control theory. Starts with a single quadrotor and gripper.
